name: syncboard
description: SyncBoard — real-time collaborative whiteboard for tutoring and teaching

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @syncboard/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c red,gray "npm run dev -w @syncboard/backend" "npm run dev -w @syncboard/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @syncboard/shared && npm run build -w @syncboard/backend && npm run build -w @syncboard/frontend
